concept: Review and integration: courage as a repeated choice, not a one-time trait
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across standing by a principle, taking initiative, and facing a real fear — which took the most out of you?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real, upcoming situation where this Pillar would apply

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
